facts.fact: The Chambre des comptes' 2024 certification work states that the Guichet unique des opérations du commerce extérieur (Guce) centralises import and export operations and serves as the reference for tracking foreign-trade financial flows, with customs revenue recorded against it.
facts.system: Guce (Guichet unique des opérations du commerce extérieur)

systems.system: Guce (Guichet unique des opérations du commerce extérieur)

facts.fact: The article refers to Cameroon's customs system CAMCIS, whose interoperability with SYDONIA World is being examined by an AFRITAC-supported mission.
Customs says Cameroon, Chad and the Central African Republic have already linked their systems and introduced joint transit procedures.

note: Describes a card payment tool for customs duties linking GUCE, Trustpayway, Visa and BGFIBank; it states nothing on declaration processing, agency joining or data exchange with another country.
The document states nothing this study asks for Cameroon.
CAMCIS is named as Cameroon's customs platform, but the article does not say what it does or that declarations run on it; the exchange system is a proposal still needing pilot acceptance.

facts.fact: The Cameroon customs director general said the interconnection between CAMCIS and Chad's SYDONIA World remains a priority, naming CAMCIS as the system Cameroon customs uses.

note: A shippers' councils protocol on corridor systems; no customs system is described.
Transit information-sharing agreement with Chad shippers council and cargo tracking note; no customs system or regional community exchange stated.

facts.fact: Cameroon's Director General of Customs says the CAMCIS customs information system has been in operation since April 2020, with its freight, clearance and revenue-collection modules launched.

The GUCE single window, a partnership of the State and operators on a platform dating from 2012, is described as issuing customs duty receipts and clearing imports and vehicles within 48 hours; a third-generation version is announced for Q1 2025.

note: Workshop report of SIGMAT status and plans; no dated customs fact for this country that the questions ask.

facts.fact: GUCE, the Single Window for Foreign Trade Operations, is reported by its own director general as having digitalised more than 35 trade procedures and, with the National Shippers' Council, exchanged more than 2 million files and cargo tracking notes between their platforms.
facts.system: GUCE (Single Window for Foreign Trade Operations)

note: Database record only; both claims are held.
Document covers payment of duties by card, not declaration processing or a single window run.
